clips.send: Stigma. Sticky tip that catches pollen (female). The top of the pistil, the female part. It is sticky or feathery so pollen grains stick to it. Pollination means pollen landing on a stigma.
clips.text: Stigma. Sticky tip that catches pollen (female). The top of the pistil, the female part.. It is sticky or feathery so pollen grains stick to it.. Pollination means pollen landing on a stigma.

clips.send: Petal. Attracts pollinators. Bright colors, patterns and scent attract bees, butterflies and birds. Many petals have “nectar guide” patterns that bees can see in ultraviolet light, which we can’t see. Wind-pollinated flowers, like grasses and corn, have tiny petals or none at all.
clips.text: Petal. Attracts pollinators. Bright colors, patterns and scent attract bees, butterflies and birds.. Many petals have “nectar guide” patterns that bees can see in ultraviolet light, which we can’t see.. Wind-pollinated flowers, like grasses and corn, have tiny petals or none at all.

clips.send: Xylem. Carries water and minerals UP. Xylem vessels are hollow tubes made of dead cells joined end to end. Water moves one way: from the roots up to the leaves. Wood is mostly old xylem. Each tree ring is one year of new xylem.
clips.text: Xylem. Carries water and minerals UP. Xylem vessels are hollow tubes made of dead cells joined end to end.. Water moves one way: from the roots up to the leaves.. Wood is mostly old xylem. Each tree ring is one year of new xylem.

clips.send: Phloem. Carries sugar (food) up and down. Phloem is made of living cells (sieve tubes). It carries sugar from the leaves, where it is made, to roots, fruits, flowers and growing tips. Aphids push their mouthparts into stems to drink sugary phloem sap.
clips.text: Phloem. Carries sugar (food) up and down. Phloem is made of living cells (sieve tubes).. It carries sugar from the leaves, where it is made, to roots, fruits, flowers and growing tips.. Aphids push their mouthparts into stems to drink sugary phloem sap.

clips.send: Filament. Holds up the anther. A thin stalk that lifts the anther up high. Raised anthers brush pollen onto visiting insects, or release it into the wind. Stamen equals anther + filament.
clips.text: Filament. Holds up the anther. A thin stalk that lifts the anther up high.. Raised anthers brush pollen onto visiting insects, or release it into the wind.. Stamen = anther + filament.

clips.send: Style. Connects stigma to ovary. A stalk that holds the stigma up. After pollination, a pollen tube grows down through the style to reach the ovules. Pistil equals stigma + style + ovary.
clips.text: Style. Connects stigma to ovary. A stalk that holds the stigma up.. After pollination, a pollen tube grows down through the style to reach the ovules.. Pistil = stigma + style + ovary.

clips.send: Anther. Makes pollen (male). The anther sits on top of the filament. Together they make the stamen, the male part. Pollen grains carry the plant’s sperm cells. One flower can make many thousands of pollen grains.
clips.text: Anther. Makes pollen (male). The anther sits on top of the filament. Together they make the stamen, the male part.. Pollen grains carry the plant’s sperm cells.. One flower can make many thousands of pollen grains.

clips.send: Leaf. Makes food by photosynthesis. The broad, flat blade catches as much sunlight as possible. Leaf veins contain xylem and phloem. Leaf cells are packed with chloroplasts.
clips.text: Leaf. Makes food by photosynthesis. The broad, flat blade catches as much sunlight as possible.. Leaf veins contain xylem and phloem.. Leaf cells are packed with chloroplasts.

clips.send: Ovary. Holds the ovules, becomes the fruit. The swollen base of the pistil. After fertilization, the ovary grows into a fruit that protects the seeds and helps spread them. Apples, tomatoes, peppers and pea pods are all ripened ovaries.
clips.text: Ovary. Holds the ovules · becomes the fruit. The swollen base of the pistil.. After fertilization, the ovary grows into a fruit that protects the seeds and helps spread them.. Apples, tomatoes, peppers and pea pods are all ripened ovaries.

clips.send: Stem. Supports the plant, transports materials. The stem holds the leaves up toward the light. It contains bundles of xylem and phloem that connect roots and leaves. Some stems store food. A potato is actually an underground stem!
clips.text: Stem. Supports the plant · transports materials. The stem holds the leaves up toward the light.. It contains bundles of xylem and phloem that connect roots and leaves.. Some stems store food. A potato is actually an underground stem!

clips.send: Root. Anchors the plant, absorbs water and minerals. Roots hold the plant firmly in the soil. Tiny root hairs give a huge surface area for absorbing water and minerals. Some roots store food, such as carrots, radishes and sweet potatoes.
clips.text: Root. Anchors the plant · absorbs water and minerals. Roots hold the plant firmly in the soil.. Tiny root hairs give a huge surface area for absorbing water and minerals.. Some roots store food, such as carrots, radishes and sweet potatoes.

clips.send: Stomata. Tiny pores for gases and water vapor. Stomata are tiny openings, mostly on the underside of leaves. Each is guarded by two guard cells. CO2 goes in; O2 and water vapor go out. Water vapor escaping through stomata is called transpiration. It pulls water up the xylem like a straw.
clips.text: Stomata. Tiny pores for gases and water vapor. Stomata are tiny openings, mostly on the underside of leaves. Each is guarded by two guard cells.. CO₂ goes in; O₂ and water vapor go out.. Water vapor escaping through stomata is called transpiration. It pulls water up the xylem like a straw.

clips.send: 茎。支撑植物 · 运输物质。茎把叶子托向阳光。茎里有由木质部和韧皮部组成的维管束，把根和叶连接起来。有些茎能储存养料。土豆其实是长在地下的茎！
clips.text: 茎. 支撑植物 · 运输物质. 茎把叶子托向阳光。. 茎里有由木质部和韧皮部组成的维管束，把根和叶连接起来。. 有些茎能储存养料。土豆其实是长在地下的茎！

clips.send: 韧皮部（筛管）。向上、向下运输糖类等有机物。韧皮部由活细胞（筛管）组成。它把叶片制造的糖运到根、果实、花和正在生长的部位。蚜虫把口器插进茎里，吸食含糖的韧皮部汁液。
clips.text: 韧皮部（筛管）. 向上、向下运输糖类等有机物. 韧皮部由活细胞（筛管）组成。. 它把叶片制造的糖运到根、果实、花和正在生长的部位。. 蚜虫把口器插进茎里，吸食含糖的韧皮部汁液。

clips.send: 气孔。气体和水蒸气进出的小孔。气孔是主要分布在叶片背面的小孔，每个气孔由两个保卫细胞围成。二氧化碳从这里进入，氧气和水蒸气从这里出去。水蒸气从气孔散失的过程叫蒸腾作用，它像吸管一样把水沿导管向上“拉”。

clips.send: 根。固定植物 · 吸收水和无机盐。根把植物牢牢地固定在土壤中。细小的根毛大大增加了吸收面积，用来吸收水和无机盐。有些根能储存养料，比如胡萝卜、萝卜和红薯。
clips.text: 根. 固定植物 · 吸收水和无机盐. 根把植物牢牢地固定在土壤中。. 细小的根毛大大增加了吸收面积，用来吸收水和无机盐。. 有些根能储存养料，比如胡萝卜、萝卜和红薯。

clips.send: 花丝。支撑花药。细细的柄，把花药举得高高的。高处的花药能把花粉蹭到来访的昆虫身上，或让风吹走花粉。雄蕊 等于 花药 + 花丝。
clips.text: 花丝. 支撑花药. 细细的柄，把花药举得高高的。. 高处的花药能把花粉蹭到来访的昆虫身上，或让风吹走花粉。. 雄蕊 = 花药 + 花丝。

clips.send: 花药。产生花粉（雄性）。花药长在花丝顶端，二者合起来叫做雄蕊，是花的雄性结构。花粉粒里含有植物的精子。一朵花可以产生成千上万粒花粉。
clips.text: 花药. 产生花粉（雄性）. 花药长在花丝顶端，二者合起来叫做雄蕊，是花的雄性结构。. 花粉粒里含有植物的精子。. 一朵花可以产生成千上万粒花粉。

clips.send: 柱头。黏黏的顶端，接受花粉（雌性）。雌蕊的顶端。雌蕊是花的雌性结构。柱头黏黏的或毛茸茸的，能粘住花粉粒。花粉落到柱头上的过程叫做传粉。
clips.text: 柱头. 黏黏的顶端，接受花粉（雌性）. 雌蕊的顶端。雌蕊是花的雌性结构。. 柱头黏黏的或毛茸茸的，能粘住花粉粒。. 花粉落到柱头上的过程叫做传粉。

clips.send: 子房。包着胚珠 · 将来发育成果实。雌蕊基部膨大的部分。受精后，子房发育成果实，保护种子并帮助种子传播。苹果、西红柿、辣椒和豆荚都是由子房发育来的。
clips.text: 子房. 包着胚珠 · 将来发育成果实. 雌蕊基部膨大的部分。. 受精后，子房发育成果实，保护种子并帮助种子传播。. 苹果、西红柿、辣椒和豆荚都是由子房发育来的。

clips.send: 萼片。保护花蕾。花瓣下方绿色、像叶子一样的结构。花开放之前，萼片像保护壳一样包住花蕾。所有萼片合在一起叫做花萼。
clips.text: 萼片. 保护花蕾. 花瓣下方绿色、像叶子一样的结构。. 花开放之前，萼片像保护壳一样包住花蕾。. 所有萼片合在一起叫做花萼。

clips.send: 木质部（导管）。向上运输水和无机盐。导管是由死细胞首尾相连形成的中空管道。水只朝一个方向流动：从根向上运到叶。木材主要就是老的木质部，每一圈年轮就是一年长出的新木质部。
clips.text: 木质部（导管）. 向上运输水和无机盐. 导管是由死细胞首尾相连形成的中空管道。. 水只朝一个方向流动：从根向上运到叶。. 木材主要就是老的木质部，每一圈年轮就是一年长出的新木质部。

clips.send: 叶。通过光合作用制造养料。宽而扁平的叶片能尽可能多地接受阳光。叶脉里有木质部和韧皮部。叶肉细胞里挤满了叶绿体。
clips.text: 叶. 通过光合作用制造养料. 宽而扁平的叶片能尽可能多地接受阳光。. 叶脉里有木质部和韧皮部。. 叶肉细胞里挤满了叶绿体。

clips.send: 花瓣。吸引传粉者。鲜艳的颜色、花纹和香味能吸引蜜蜂、蝴蝶和鸟。许多花瓣上有“蜜导”花纹，蜜蜂能在紫外光下看见，而人眼看不见。靠风传粉的花（如草和玉米）花瓣很小，甚至没有花瓣。
